dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-pigmented perimeters are visible on the mid-lateral flank. The largest central annuli shows a jagged, high-frequency edge with a sharp gradient transition from a bright exterior border to a dark, low-intensity interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of diffuse, high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated in the posterior ventral-lateral region, appearing as chaotic, filamentous patches rather than discrete solid blobs. Low density of localized solid blobs on the primary dorsal surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent lateral annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the primary vertex located at the largest central ring and the shorter leg extending towards the anterior flipper.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced high-contrast, wispy white fur patterning on the posterior underbelly and flipper area, distinct from the geometric annuli observed on the mid-section.
